method.symbolCoordinates: zero based CDP call frames; matched to source bodies in hashed production assets
method.leadingDeltaTreatment: Exclude first sample/delta: it includes Profiler.start initialization before measurement. Raw profiles retain it. Function timing is sampled attribution normalized by the bridge measured frame count; profile start/stop and bridge boundaries are not exactly coincident.
method.hostAndMainThreadOnly: V8 samples cover the renderer main thread, not Rust, GPU process, compositor, or workers.
method.qualityAblation: none disables mapped and analytic shadows and changes receivers too; total savings cannot be assigned solely to caster selection.
method.coLoad: During the V8 block, diagnostic Python profile aggregation ran between observations and may overlap windows. The separate without-V8 block ran after it, without heavy aggregation. V8 results support attribution; without-V8 results carry the performance comparison.
method.liveDrift: Compare pairs in one session. Counts are snapshot workloads, not frozen inputs; sun, animation, mobs, and particle populations can vary.
method.countAudit: Vite development frontend / release host, 300 frames each; query, descriptor, and clone counters only. Off/on sessions differ slightly in viewport and live populations. Mapped audit had renderer phase profiling enabled, none audit disabled; neither is timing evidence.

disposition.primaryOpportunity: Separate actor-eligible shadow query inputs before bounds traversal and descriptor construction; preserve conservative particle bounds for ordinary rendering.
disposition.copyOpportunity: Use a renderer-owned synchronous borrow contract where proven safe; do not globally weaken copying inspection APIs or retain borrowed scene transforms across mutation.
disposition.notEstablished: No proposed optimization has measured shadow-preserving savings or full correctness proof yet; disabling shadows is a quality ablation.
disposition.gpuCandidate: Direct interpolated-depth replacement remains rejected by the boundary fixture.

probePreparationAndCleanup.invalidPreparations: Initial mapped enum was wrong; later retained DOM controls were detached because Settings unmounts on close. Six mislabeled windows from that failed control attempt plus one baseline from a failed preflight are excluded. Valid capture reacquires connected controls and verifies renderer target allocation before each window.
probePreparationAndCleanup.preferenceCleanup: The valid timing capture restored the UI setting but exited before its debounced persistence completed. The first count audit found no active shadow maps. The mapped audit then explicitly saved shadow-maps and verified saved mode plus 8388608 active bytes before collecting 300 frames. Original preference is restored.
probePreparationAndCleanup.sourceVersions: cpu-shadow-captured-probe is the exact measurement source. cpu-shadow-probe adds explicit persistent restoration for future runs; its changed cleanup was not rerun as a timing capture. The count-only hook is shared by both audit sessions; the retained mapped audit source adds mode initialization/restoration versus the initial none audit.
